start.speaker: Mara
start.text: You shouldn't be down here after dark. Kanzaki's boys don't like eyes on the water.

choices.text: What comes in on the night shipments?
The badge said 'Renner.' You knew him?
Did you know the dead reporter?

shipments.speaker: Mara
shipments.text: Sealed drums. No labels, no scans. One splits open now and then — the fish float up dead for a week after. Container KZ-7's the worst of it. Nobody's cleared to crack that one.

discover.title: Mara's Testimony
discover.desc: A dockworker says Kanzaki lands unlabeled sealed drums; when one leaks the harbor goes dead for a week. KZ-7 is the container no one's allowed to open.

renner.speaker: Mara
renner.text: Renner. Yeah. Slipped me a hundred to look away while he photographed KZ-7. I told him to run. He didn't run fast enough. That's on me, detective. Some of it.

discover.title: Renner's Last Night
discover.desc: Mara says the dead reporter, Renner, bribed her to photograph Container KZ-7 the night he died. He got too close to the truth.

crews.speaker: Mara
crews.text: Kanzaki's own men — hoods up, no names. And the inspector, Halloran, signs whatever they land. Clean paperwork for dirty water. You didn't hear it from me.

victim.speaker: Mara
victim.text: Came asking the same questions you are. Then he stopped coming. Take the hint, detective.

bye.speaker: Mara
bye.text: Smart. The water keeps its secrets. Mostly.
